description: Codex's `codex login --device-auth` screen: a link to open, a one-time code, and a closing 'Enter code ABCD-12345'. That line tells the user to type the code in the BROWSER; the CLI shows no input prompt (no › composer, the cursor on a blank row below). The parser read it as a text question, the phone offered a Reply button, and tapping it typed the code into the pane. classify() now drops a Codex text question with no composer on screen and makes the pane an external wait (tests/test_classify.py proves the override). The link and code stay as links/copyables. Live capture with a fake code (tmux-rc, 2026-10-14).
